build_siglip_vision_transformer: build a SiglipVisionTransformer model from a SiglipVisionConfig and weights for image feature extraction
create_siglip_attention: create a SiglipAttention multi-headed attention layer with tensor parallel QKV projections for the SigLIP model
implement_siglip_encoder_layer: implement a SiglipEncoderLayer with pre-layer-norm self-attention and MLP residual blocks for the SigLIP encoder
build_siglip_mlp: build a SiglipMLP feed-forward network with tensor parallel fc1 and fc2 layers and configurable activation function
create_siglip_pooling_head: create a SiglipMultiheadAttentionPoolingHead that uses a learnable probe token to pool encoder hidden states
